name: Sour jujube seed (suanzaoren)
short: In a meta-analysis of 9 randomised trials, suanzaoren did not increase major adverse events; the authors said harms, particularly long term, need further study.
text: In a systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 randomised trials (785 participants with insomnia disorder and 120 with sleep disturbance), suanzaoren did not increase the incidence of major adverse events; the authors concluded that, because of small sample sizes and variable study quality, its harms, particularly in the long term, should be assessed further. In a small placebo-controlled crossover trial in 12 participants over four-week periods, the seed was well tolerated with only minor adverse events. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
